description: Experience the thrill of motor-boating through a maze of mangrove lined waterways in the Caroni Swamp, home of the exotic Scarlet Ibis, our National Bird. This journey gives the opportunity to experience mammals, reptiles, marine organisms and many species of birds. Listed opening hours: 5 am - 7 pm. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
